query: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber:'R3-258530'})-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(origin:Company) WITH t,a,m,collect(DISTINCT origin) AS origins MATCH (other:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a), (other)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m), (other)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WHERE NOT c IN origins RETURN DISTINCT c.companyName AS companyName,other.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
